title: 我的一天 · My day
subtitle: Day 01 · Version 2 · Speaking rehearsal
sourceNote: Hanzi verified against the owner-approved 26-sentence transcript; pinyin and English retained from the matching supplied Day01 V2 HTML.

rows.hanzi: 我每天八点左右醒来。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān bā diǎn zuǒyòu xǐnglái.
rows.english: I wake up at around eight every day.

rows.hanzi: 二十到三十分钟后，我起床。
rows.pinyin: Èrshí dào sānshí fēnzhōng hòu, wǒ qǐchuáng.
rows.english: Twenty to thirty minutes later, I get out of bed.

rows.hanzi: 然后我去厨房做早饭。
rows.pinyin: Ránhòu wǒ qù chúfáng zuò zǎofàn.
rows.english: Then I go to the kitchen and make breakfast.

rows.hanzi: 因为我不吃肉，所以早饭我做素菜。
rows.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ bù chī ròu, suǒyǐ zǎofàn wǒ zuò sùcài.
rows.english: Because I don't eat meat, I make vegetarian dishes for breakfast.

rows.hanzi: 然后我吃早饭。
rows.pinyin: Ránhòu wǒ chī zǎofàn.
rows.english: Then I eat breakfast.

rows.hanzi: 早饭后，我准备出门，因为我得去学校。
rows.pinyin: Zǎofàn hòu, wǒ zhǔnbèi chūmén, yīnwèi wǒ děi qù xuéxiào.
rows.english: After breakfast, I get ready to leave home because I have to go to school.

rows.hanzi: 我走出家门，走路去学校。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ zǒuchū jiāmén, zǒulù qù xuéxiào.
rows.english: I walk out of my home and walk to school.

rows.hanzi: 我家离学校很近，走路只要十分钟。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn jìn, zǒulù zhǐ yào shí fēnzhōng.
rows.english: My home is close to school; the walk takes only ten minutes.

rows.hanzi: 路上，我用微信点一杯咖啡。
rows.pinyin: Lùshang, wǒ yòng Wēixìn diǎn yì bēi kāfēi.
rows.english: On the way, I order a coffee using WeChat.

rows.hanzi: 到学校以后，我在楼下取咖啡。
rows.pinyin: Dào xuéxiào yǐhòu, wǒ zài lóuxià qǔ kāfēi.
rows.english: After arriving at school, I pick up my coffee downstairs.

rows.hanzi: 然后我走进教室。
rows.pinyin: Ránhòu wǒ zǒujìn jiàoshì.
rows.english: Then I walk into the classroom.

rows.hanzi: 我的课早上八点四十分开始。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ de kè zǎoshang bā diǎn sìshí fēn kāishǐ.
rows.english: My class starts at 8:40 a.m.

rows.hanzi: 十点十分，我们休息二十分钟。
rows.pinyin: Shí diǎn shí fēn, wǒmen xiūxi èrshí fēnzhōng.
rows.english: At 10:10, we have a twenty-minute break.

rows.hanzi: 休息的时候，我走出教室。
rows.pinyin: Xiūxi de shíhou, wǒ zǒuchū jiàoshì.
rows.english: During the break, I walk out of the classroom.

rows.hanzi: 中午十二点，我们休息一个小时。
rows.pinyin: Zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn, wǒmen xiūxi yí ge xiǎoshí.
rows.english: At noon, we have a one-hour break.

rows.hanzi: 我吃午饭。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ chī wǔfàn.
rows.english: I eat lunch.

rows.hanzi: 下午一点，我还有一个半小时的中文课。
rows.pinyin: Xiàwǔ yì diǎn, wǒ hái yǒu yí ge bàn xiǎoshí de Zhōngwén kè.
rows.english: At 1 p.m., I have another ninety-minute Chinese class.

rows.hanzi: 下午两点半下课以后，我回家。
rows.pinyin: Xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn bàn xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒ huí jiā.
rows.english: After class ends at 2:30 p.m., I go home.

rows.hanzi: 到家以后，我进屋开始工作。
rows.pinyin: Dào jiā yǐhòu, wǒ jìn wū kāishǐ gōngzuò.
rows.english: When I get home, I go inside and start working.

rows.hanzi: 我在家工作，也学中文。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ zài jiā gōngzuò, yě xué Zhōngwén.
rows.english: I work from home and also study Chinese.

rows.hanzi: 下午我通常出去散步。
rows.pinyin: Xiàwǔ wǒ tōngcháng chūqù sànbù.
rows.english: In the afternoon, I usually go out for a walk.

rows.hanzi: 有时候我走半个小时，有时候走两个小时。
rows.pinyin: Yǒu shíhou wǒ zǒu bàn ge xiǎoshí, yǒu shíhou zǒu liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
rows.english: Sometimes I walk for half an hour, sometimes for two hours.

rows.hanzi: 我在附近走走，有时候买点东西。
rows.pinyin: Wǒ zài fùjìn zǒuzou, yǒu shíhou mǎi diǎn dōngxi.
rows.english: I walk around the neighborhood and sometimes buy a few things.

rows.hanzi: 然后我回到家，继续工作。
rows.pinyin: Ránhòu wǒ huí dào jiā, jìxù gōngzuò.
rows.english: Then I return home and continue working.

rows.hanzi: 晚上我练习中文。
rows.pinyin: Wǎnshang wǒ liànxí Zhōngwén.
rows.english: In the evening, I practice Chinese.

rows.hanzi: 晚上十一点左右，我上床睡觉。
rows.pinyin: Wǎnshang shíyī diǎn zuǒyòu, wǒ shàngchuáng shuìjiào.
rows.english: At around 11 p.m., I go to bed.

movement.english: go out, away from the speaker
